releaseNotes: Bottom tabs now slide between pages in the direction of navigation while the header and tab bar remain stationary.
Rapid taps no longer produce browser transition errors. Older WebViews and reduced-motion preferences are supported.
Shopping no longer repeats the Find cheaper meals or Lower-cost meals control. Lower-cost planning remains in Shop Prep and Settings.
Removed obsolete Shopping styles and added persistent regression checks to guard the navigation design.
Completed extensive phone, iPhone and tablet page, control and shopping regression testing without changing existing meals or data.
